function.name: get_rule_pack
function.description: Return the atomic rules (id, type, requirement, accepted alternatives, ignore scopes, cannot-determine conditions) for the exact pinned rule-pack version. Call once per request before adjudicating. Fails if the version does not exist; never substitute another version.

rule_pack_id.description: Rule pack identifier from the request, e.g. contoso-storefront

version.description: Exact semantic version from the request, e.g. 1.0.0

function.name: retrieve_policy_guidance
function.description: Return interpretation guidance (exceptions, accepted alternatives, scoping notes) for the given category and rule-pack version. Use it to interpret rules, not to change them. If it returns an error, continue with the rule text only and add a note to uncertainties.

category.description: Inspection category from the request, e.g. storefront
